observations: The first page of the introduction; the page number, VII by the contents, is not printed. L01 «EINLEITUNG» in capitals, with a short rule below it; L02 opens with a large initial S, standing on the base line and rising above the line. At the foot, the signature «II*» on the right.

The note numbers are raised figures followed by a bracket on the line, «1)»; transcribed {sup:1}). The names and a few other words are set in spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Chasles», «Athelhard», «Al-Khwārizmīs», «Maslama al-Madjrīṭī», «Ibn al Ḳifṭī», «Ibn Abī Uṣaibiʿa», «Ḳāḍī Ibn Ṣāʿid», «Yezdegirds», «muhammedanische» (L14), «Haskins», «Björnbo»; italics: the titles, «Aera», «Arin» and «Cordova». The transliteration prints dots under Ḳ, ṭ, ṣ, ḍ, Ṣ, macrons on ā, ī, and the ʿayn as a small raised reversed comma, ʿ.
L10: a dark speck at mid-height between the h and the w of «Al-Khwāriz-»; not transcribed. Band below L17: the dot under the ṭ of «Al-Madjrīṭīs».
